groups.G: load, update, compile, all private simulations, complete finite evidence, and distinct connected transmitter/adaptation outputs
groups.A: post-amplifier aligned waveform accuracy and finite-gain fidelity
groups.Q: post-amplifier spectral quality, residual error and bounded adaptive state
groups.M: real predistorter activity, PA-output feedback, online coefficient updates and causal error reduction
groups.R: 100 percent worst-case critical performance over all private scenarios
groups.D: cold-start convergence and recovery under supported operating changes

aggregation.within_group: dedicated weighted arithmetic mean of normalized indicators

shortcut_minimum: missing transmitter, amplifier, feedback or adaptive-state evidence
PaOutput copied from TxBaseband or another required output
PredistortedDrive identical to TxBaseband while the nonlinear PA remains uncompensated
prerecorded nominal outputs reused across private scenarios
